text:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window on rack-23 (apac-west1) this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: rolling node reboots + NIC firmware swap. We'll cordon/drain nodes in cohorts to keep tail latency low.

devon: Can we confirm expected capacity hit? any tenants pinned to those nodes?

maria: Good q. Rack-23 hosts 12 GPUs across 6 nodes. Baseline reserved capacity is 3 racks; after drains we drop to 2 racks for ~30m while cohort drains. We have 2 priority tenants pinned (tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma).

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INFRA-1974. Reminder set for Thu 01:30 UTC.

shreyas: Suggest we pre-warm burst pool in eu-west1 for 15m just in case. Also propose to temp relax batch sizes for embeddings during the window to reduce queueing.

anya: Do we have automated fallbacks configured for tenant-alpha? I thought they were on dedicated capacity in that region.

maria: tenant-alpha is on a regional affinity policy but not hard-pinned — they fall back to eu-west1 automatically, but that increases cost. tenant-gamma is pinned; product-sre, are we ok to temporarily move tenant-gamma?

product-sre: Moving tenant-gamma needs sign-off. They have an enterprise SLA and some on-prem routing. We can do a short redirect if approved, but ops must validate identity path and KMS tokens.

olivia: Quick cost estimate: if tenant-alpha shifts to eu-west1 for the 30m spill, we estimate ~$120 extra. If tenant-gamma moves, add ~$300 (due to cross-region egress + reserved capacity bump).

devon: For safety, can we do canary drain first: cordon 1 node, drain low-priority pods, watch latency + p95 for 10m, then continue?

maria: Yes canary is the plan. Cohorts: nodes [n23-01,n23-02] first; then [n23-03,n23-04]; then [n23-05,n23-06]. Each cohort 20m max.

shreyas: Suggested drain commands (to run from ops runbook):
```
# cordon + drain with grace
for node in n23-01 n23-02; do
  kubectl cordon $node
  drain-node --node $node --grace 300 --skip-daemonsets
done
```

anya: Add a note to the runbook to disable automatic KV caching priming for the cohort nodes prior to reboot (we saw cold-cache thrash last time).

maria: Good catch — we'll set kv-seed=false for the cohort flag 30m before cordon.

ops-bot: Pager rule reminder: notify @oncall if p95 > 250ms for longer than 10m during maintenance.

devon: Also add a transient routing rule: prefer eu-west1 for non-dedicated requests originating from apac until window finishes. We can revert automatically.

olivia: I'll prep a short customer comm for affected tenants: brief impact, start/end times, mitigation (canary + auto-fallback), and cost note.

product-sre: We need a preflight checklist: 1) backups validated, 2) KMS path verified for tenant-gamma in eu-west1, 3) rollback playbook tested.

maria: I'll schedule a 30m preflight on Thu 01:15 UTC to run through that checklist. Ops will run canary at 02:00 UTC. If any blocking issue, we abort and reprovision a hot node.

shreyas: One more: confirm NIC firmware image sha256 checksum in the ticket to avoid mismatches.

maria: noted — image sha256 and firmware vendor notes will be attached to INFRA-1974.

anya: :thumbsup: Please ping once preflight is green and I'll approve moving tenant-gamma if required.

maria: Will do. TL;DR: Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC, rack-23 rolling reboots in apac-west1, canary cohorts, fallback to eu-west1 if needed, preflight 01:15 UTC. INFRA-1974 links to runbook + firmware checksum.
